本技能从创意/原始文本出发，一站式完成标准剧本转换、视觉资产提取、设定图生成、分: Starting from an idea or raw text, it handles in one stop: standard script conversion, visual asset extraction, concept image generation, storyboard and camera design, asset matching and the final video, with user confirmation and adjustment at every step, covering the entire process from idea to short film. 本技能基于四维解构框架创作15秒单镜头视觉叙事视频prompt，通过视觉锚点、动: Creates 15-second single-shot visual narrative video prompts based on a four-dimension deconstruction framework, building striking visuals through visual anchors, dynamic vectors and high-entropy details, avoiding flat storytelling in favor of a distinctive, extreme visual expression.
本技能基于用户上传的一张或多张图片，生成电影短片、电影预告、TVC广告、品牌广告:
Based on one or more images uploaded by the user, it generates many types of video: short films, trailers, TVC ads, brand ads, product ads, social media shorts, IP character teasers, designer toy launches, fashion editorials, music visuals, documentary-style shorts, e-commerce videos and launch-event screen videos. The workflow covers visual gene deconstruction, video category selection, video structure planning, dialogue/narration/subtitle setup, visual expansion boundaries, short film plans, a high-density shot table, multi_modal2video
omni-reference segmented generation, and final stitching with video_editor. The video generation stage injects only the shot content from the shot table, nothing outside it, and no Markdown table symbols or formatting characters.
本技能帮助普通创作者从零孵化一个讨喜、好记、可持续拍短视频的治愈系原创 IP。输: Helps ordinary creators incubate, from scratch, a likable, memorable healing-style original IP that can sustain short videos. It does not directly generate complete short videos, and does not handle imitations of well-known IPs, brand-infringing character replicas, or simple avatar beautification.
本技能是自动化短剧工业生成系统，可根据一句话剧情自动完成从概念到视频提示词的完整: An automated short drama production system that turns a one-line premise into a complete production pipeline from concept to video prompts, supporting multi-episode series generation and asset consistency control. 本技能根据模特和产品信息，生成15-30秒符合UGC病毒传播逻辑的TikTok带: Generates 15-30 second TikTok sales video scripts that follow UGC viral logic from model and product information, with four classic template matches, suited to native-feeling sales videos. The core is multi_modal2video (omni-reference): the character image is referenced by the prompt as @Image1, and composition and proportion are fully controlled by the prompt, fundamentally preventing out-of-frame bleed (the image2video first-frame mode is not used, as it locks the composition and inevitably bleeds out of frame). A very small proportion in the first image (the costume image) is the number one factor in preventing bleed. Supports pure-text, no-image starts: break a one-line request into character and action, fill in anchors automatically, generate the costume image with text2image, then generate the video. Prompts are kept concise (80-150 characters) to keep the action faithful, effects are limited to an invisible red box, and duration is 4-6 seconds by action complexity. Chain: request_user_input -> text2image (when no image) -> multi_modal2video. 通用故事开发skill（跨项目通用，与任何具体项目解耦）。负责故事维度的工作：从: A general story development skill (cross-project, decoupled from any specific project). It handles story-level work: developing from scratch (idea -> positioning statement -> logline -> character setup -> beat sheet -> treatment) and diagnosis and repair (locating and fixing structure, character and plot problems in an existing story). The core is a good-story evaluation system (three thresholds: complete/coherent/followable; four axes: appeal/caring/emotion/meaning) + a seven-step generation process + a library of structure anchors (three-act/Save the Cat/Hero's Journey/four-part structure/micro-drama beats, etc.). Applies to all narrative forms: animated features, live-action films, series, shorts, micro-dramas, game narratives and ad narratives. It stops at the treatment/beat sheet; script text (dialogue/scenes/action description) is handed to the screenwriter. Trigger words: story, write a story, make up a story, story development, logline, story outline, treatment, beat sheet, story idea, topic selection, story diagnosis, character biography, character arc, protagonist, antagonist, story structure, three-act, revision, botched ending, ending. 通用编剧/剧本skill（跨项目通用，与任何具体项目解耦）。负责把故事蓝图写成剧:
A general screenwriting skill (cross-project, decoupled from any specific project). It turns a story blueprint into script text: scene writing (enter late, leave early / conflict in every scene) + dialogue (subtext/character voice/function) + action description (visual writing), and diagnoses and repairs existing scripts and dialogue. Root principle: a script only writes what can be seen and heard, and the craft lies in subtext. Three axes: visual action/dialogue subtext/scene economy. Adapts to the format (animation leans on dialogue plus key action; series produce full dialogue scripts).
Trigger words: script, screenwriter, write a script, revise a script, dialogue, lines, conversation, subtext, on-the-nose, scene, action line, screenplay format, literary script, dialogue diagnosis, dialogue too direct, lines do not sound human, scene drags, character voice, voiceover script.
Also trigger when the user says "write this story as a script", "how should I revise this dialogue", "the lines feel fake/too direct", "this scene drags", "all the characters talk the same", or "write a scene".
通用美术设定/世界观skill（跨项目通用，与任何具体项目解耦）。负责世界与场景: A general art direction and worldbuilding skill (cross-project, decoupled from any specific project). It handles the content design of worlds and scenes: worldbuilding (core rules/systems/history/culture/language/myth) + art direction (architecture/costume/objects/color/landmarks/visual motifs) + scene concept image prompt generation, outputs a world bible (the world's constitution), and diagnoses and repairs existing world settings. Core theory: build a world that stands on its own for a story, with four axes (believable/distinctive/expressive/emotional tone) designed in two groups across three layers (core/system/visual). Trigger words: worldview, worldbuilding, art direction, setting book, scene design, environment design, world setting, setting, world bible, world constitution, scene concept image, scene concept art, landmark design, fictional world, world rules, cultural setting. Also trigger when the user says "build a world", "design this world/scene", "the worldview does not hold up/has no character", "this setting is not believable", or "produce a scene concept image".
通用角色设计skill（跨项目通用，与任何具体项目解耦）。负责从人设到完整角色设:
A general character design skill (cross-project, decoupled from any specific project). It handles all work from persona to complete character design: core setup (desire/contradiction/belief/gap/inner-outer relationship) ->
behavior design (decision pattern/language signature/movement signature/expression range) -> visual concept design (shape language/proportion/color/costume and props/signature features) -> character concept sheet prompt generation (exploration variants/costume portrait/turnaround/expression sheet/pose sheet/proportion chart), and diagnosis and repair of existing characters (do not hold up/no distinctiveness/no charm).
Trigger words: character design, persona, create a character, character, concept sheet, portrait art, turnaround, expression sheet, pose sheet, character concept, character design, costume design, character appearance, shape
language, silhouette, recognizability, character charm, protagonist design, villain design, supporting character design, character setting pack, character bible. Also trigger when the user says "design a character", "this character does not hold up/has no distinctiveness/no charm/no memorable point", "produce a character concept sheet/portrait art/turnaround", or "help me deepen this persona".
Boundary: this skill is a concept design skill, and its output is always a white-background concept sheet (no environment, no scene); composite images of characters in environments belong to the asset image generation/storyboard skills.
